core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
qualifier: copper, manganese and cadmium, with cadmium detoxification and metallothionein binding
name: Copper, manganese and cadmium transport and detoxification
rationale: All members concern transport, homeostasis or detoxification of copper, manganese, cadmium or cobalt (incl. metallothioneins and ceruloplasmin), distinguishing it from the zinc (C1, C2), iron/heme (C3) and MTF1 metal-response (C4) neighbours, which lack cadmium detoxification.

qualifier: catecholamine and serotonin, with sympathoadrenal development
name: Monoamine synthesis and degradation with sympathoadrenal development
rationale: Members cover catecholamine and serotonin biosynthesis, MAO/COMT degradation and serotonin handling plus adrenal, sympathetic ganglion and noradrenergic neuron development, which the transporter-focused (C2, C4), BH4 (C1) and organic cation (C3) neighbours lack.

qualifier: ISG15 and interferon-stimulated genes
name: ISG15-driven interferon-stimulated restriction of viral replication
rationale: Members combine ISG15 conjugation and interferon-alpha-stimulated antiviral effectors with host control of viral genome replication, protein levels, invasion and release; C2 lacks the ISG15/IFN arm and C1, C3, C4 are type I IFN signalling without the viral life-cycle restriction terms.

qualifier: serine, glycine and proline, with vitamin B6 activation
name: Vitamin B6 and serine, glycine, proline metabolism
rationale: Members cover PLP (vitamin B6) metabolism together with serine, glycine, proline, glyoxylate and aspartate-family amino acid synthesis and catabolism, unlike the aromatic/histidine catabolism (C2) and sulfur/molybdenum cofactor (C1, C3, C4) neighbours.

qualifier: with eIF5A hypusination
name: Polyamine metabolism and transport with eIF5A hypusination
rationale: Members cover putrescine, spermidine and spermine synthesis, oxidation, ODC regulation and transport plus spermidine-dependent eIF5A hypusine synthesis and translation elongation, which the methionine salvage (C1), tryptophan/NAD (C3) and protein hydroxylation (C2, C4) neighbours lack.

qualifier: intestinal HNF4/CDX epithelium and pancreatic progenitors
name: Intestinal epithelial identity and pancreatic progenitor lineage differentiation
rationale: Most members describe HNF4/CDX-driven intestinal absorptive epithelium, crypt stem cells and pancreatic progenitor, ductal and endocrine lineages (with minor adrenal and leukocyte outliers), distinguishing it from definitive endoderm (C1), reproductive gland (C2, C4) and beta-cell/incretin (C3) neighbours.

qualifier: phagocytosis and antibody-dependent cytotoxicity
name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis and antibody-dependent cytotoxicity
rationale: All members concern Fc-gamma receptor activation and regulation driving phagocytic cup formation, ADCC and type II hypersensitivity, distinguishing it from BCR (C1), Fc-epsilon/mast cell (C2) and inhibitory B-cell (C3, C4) neighbours.

qualifier: positive regulation with IL-2 production
name: Positive regulation of TCR signalling and IL-2 production
rationale: The three members are positive TCR signalling, a T-cell activation module and IL-2 induction, contrasting with co-inhibition (C1), T-cell differentiation (C2, C4) and B-cell (C3) neighbours.

qualifier: organic acidemias with biotin and lipoyl cofactor defects
name: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism and biotin/lipoyl cofactor disorders
rationale: Members cover BCAA, lysine and short-chain acyl-CoA catabolism, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases, protein lipoylation, biotin-dependent carboxylases and their inborn errors (MSUD, isovaleric acidemia), which the vitamin B6 (C1), TCA cycle (C2, C3) and CoA/PDH regulation (C4) neighbours lack.

qualifier: including BCKDH defects of maple syrup urine disease
name: Mitochondrial 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and maple syrup urine disease
rationale: All members are reactions or defects of the PDH, OGDH, OADH and BCKDH complexes, notably MSUD variants absent from C1-C3, while PDH/OGDH succinyl-CoA synthesis separates it from the broader BCAA-catabolism neighbour C4.

qualifier: vitamin D and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation
name: Vitamin D and vitamin K metabolism with gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members cover vitamin D activation/inactivation (CYP27B1, CYP24A1) and vitamin K metabolism with protein gamma-carboxylation, plus CYP26 defects, distinguishing it from vitamin E/ubiquinol (C1), retinoid (C2, C4) and phosphate/mineralization (C3) neighbours.

qualifier: with oxidized-LDL foam cell formation and amyloid-beta clearance
name: Efferocytosis and macrophage oxidized-LDL foam cell formation
rationale: Members cover recognition, phosphatidylserine signalling and engulfment of apoptotic cells plus oxLDL response, foam cell differentiation, cholesterol storage and amyloid-beta clearance, which the scavenger receptor (C1, C2, C4) and microglia (C3) neighbours lack.

qualifier: UV, phorbol ester and nitric oxide stimuli
name: AP-1 immediate-early response to UV and stress stimuli
rationale: Members are AP-1/NR4A immediate-early gene programmes induced by UV, PMA, nitric oxide, TNF and growth factors, distinguished from the JNK/TAK1 kinase (C2, C4) and FOSL/KRAS (C1, C3) neighbours by the UV and stimulus-response terms.

core: Cytidine deaminase restriction of retroviral replication
qualifier: APOBEC3G versus HIV-1 Vif
name: APOBEC3G-mediated restriction of HIV-1 by cytosine deamination
rationale: Members concern DNA cytosine deamination by APOBEC3G restricting reverse-transcribing viruses and its Vif-mediated degradation, distinct from HIV entry/reverse transcription (C1) and RNA editing or somatic hypermutation (C2-C4) neighbours.

qualifier: dendritic cell differentiation and costimulation
name: Dendritic cell differentiation and costimulatory T cell activation
rationale: Members cover regulation of dendritic cell differentiation and activation and the costimulatory, MHC-contact-driven activation and proliferation of T cells, unlike the T-cell inhibitory (C1, C2), NK regulation (C3) and surface signature (C4) neighbours.

core: Actin cytoskeleton control of cell shape
qualifier: Rho GTPase-regulated filopodia
name: Rho GTPase-regulated filopodium dynamics and cell-shape polarity
rationale: Members concern RHOF and citron-mediated Rho signalling, EPHB forward signalling, filopodium assembly, actin localization and polarity of cell shape, which the dendritic spine/synapse (C1-C3) and lamellipodial motility (C4) neighbours lack.

core: Neutral amino acid plasma membrane transport
qualifier: SLC6A19 and Hartnup disorder
name: SLC6A19 neutral amino acid transport and Hartnup disorder
rationale: Members cover glycine and tryptophan uptake and SLC6A19 defects causing Hartnup disorder, distinguishing it from cationic/branched-chain (C1, C4), oligopeptide (C2) and proline/iminoglycinuria (C3) transport neighbours.

qualifier: heart chambers, valves, conduction system and vessels with BMP signalling
name: Heart chamber, valve and blood vessel morphogenesis
rationale: Members span cardiac chamber, septum, valve, endocardial cushion and conduction-system development, cardiomyocyte growth and arterial/venous/lymphatic vessel formation with BMP signalling, unlike smooth-muscle adaptation (C1, C2), gastrulation (C3) and Hox body patterning (C4) neighbours.

qualifier: assembly, disassembly and inositol phosphate transport
name: Nuclear pore complex dynamics and inositol phosphate transport
rationale: Members concern NPC assembly, mitotic disassembly and reformation and nucleocytoplasmic transport of inositol phosphates and Rev, which the nuclear envelope (C1, C3) and general nuclear import/export (C2, C4) neighbours lack.

core: Class I cytokine receptor JAK-STAT signalling
qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin and leptin
name: Growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptor JAK-STAT signalling
rationale: All members are GH, prolactin or leptin receptor signalling, distinguished from thyroid/growth regulation (C1-C3) and erythropoietin/thrombopoietin (C4) neighbours by prolactin and leptin.

qualifier: Fc and complement receptor-driven
name: Fc and complement receptor-driven myeloid inflammatory responses
rationale: Members combine Fc and complement receptor signalling, ADCC, hypersensitivity, neutrophil degranulation and monocyte/macrophage/neutrophil modules, distinguishing it from FcgR phagocytosis (C1), formyl peptide chemotaxis (C2), myeloid marker (C3) and microbial killing (C4) neighbours.

qualifier: Tfh help via ICOS and memory B cells
name: Germinal center Tfh help and memory B cell formation
rationale: Members cover Tfh differentiation, ICOS costimulation, germinal center B cell differentiation and memory B cell signatures, separating it from lymphoid activation/plasma cell (C1-C3) and B-cell homeostasis (C4) neighbours.

qualifier: white, brown and beige with thermogenesis
name: White, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis
rationale: Members cover white, brown and beige fat cell differentiation, PPARG regulation and cold- or diet-induced thermogenesis, which the fatty acid cycling (C1) and lipid droplet/triglyceride (C2-C4) neighbours lack.

qualifier: pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, salvage and catabolism
name: Pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, salvage and catabolism
rationale: Members cover de novo pyrimidine synthesis, salvage and catabolism and deoxyribonucleotide (including purine dNTP) metabolism, distinguishing it from purine ribonucleotide synthesis (C3, C4), NMP phosphorylation (C2) and ADA/PNP defect (C1) neighbours.

qualifier: against deadenylation decay, with translation promotion
name: mRNA stabilization against deadenylation with enhanced translation
rationale: The three members concern protecting mRNA from deadenylation-dependent decay (including CRD-mediated stabilization) and promoting cytoplasmic translation, unlike ARE-mediated destabilization (C1), miRNA silencing (C2), decapping decay (C3) and stress granule (C4) neighbours.
